name: Nigeria Flood Watch
region: Niger and Benue river basins, Nigeria
objective: Revisit the flood basins every 3 days, deliver at least 80% of images, and survive 18 months.
brief: Seasonal floods displace millions along the Niger and Benue rivers. Design a small Earth-observation satellite that gives responders a fresh flood map every three days, without blowing the national space agency's budget.

name: Gulf Algae Watch
region: Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean coast
objective: Revisit coastal waters every 2 days, deliver 75% of images, and survive 12 months.
brief: Harmful algal blooms threaten fisheries and drinking water. A compact ocean-colour imager needs frequent passes and a patient downlink plan.

name: Atlantic Storm Watch
objective: Revisit the tropics every 12 hours, deliver 85% of images, and survive 24 months.
brief: Hurricane forecasters need a persistent eye on the tropics. Geostationary or fast-revisit polar options both work, but each carries a different cost.

name: Ice Sheet Sentinel
objective: Revisit the ice sheets every 2 days, deliver 85% of data, and survive 24 months.
brief: Radar or high-resolution optics can track crevasses and glacier flow. The polar orbit is unforgiving: radiation, eclipses, and huge data volumes.
